content: Hello! how can I help today?
I heard I can rent my house to my business for 14 days tax-free. Is that real?
Yes. Under **IRC §280A(g)**, if you rent out your personal residence for **fewer than 15 days** in a year, the income is **completely tax-exempt**—no reporting required.
Can I rent it to my own business for meetings?
Yes. If the rental is for a **legitimate business purpose**, your S corp or LLC may deduct the rental fee as a business expense while you receive the income **tax-free** personally.
How should I set the rental rate?
Use **comparable venue rates** in your area—conference rooms, coworking spaces, etc.—and document with screenshots or quotes. Reasonable pricing is key to withstand IRS scrutiny.
Do I need a written lease or invoice?
Yes. Draft a **short-term rental agreement** and issue an invoice from yourself to the business. The corporation should issue payment and deduct it on its return (e.g., on Schedule C or Form 1120-S).
